pages.text: Sync grows 5%% a minute while you ride; on the first climb, each ring you hit adds 3%%. A body moves its own way from the first second: a flier flies, a spider climbs, a chicken floats. At 25%% its other traits work.

At 50%% $(k:key.headinajar.ability) fires its ability, at 75%% $(k:key.headinajar.secondary) the second (blaze, enderman, ravager and the five of Every Body Does Something). At 100%%: 10%% stronger.$(br2)A seconded head earns $(l)team sync$() at work instead; it counts for the lace.
